premises.text: Many couples face relationship challenges that traditional therapy does not effectively address
premises.evidence_span: 11% to 18% of people that go to therapy find it to be not effective

premises.text: Couples need a solution that fits their everyday life to address relationship challenges
premises.evidence_span: we needed something that worked in my entrepreneurial lifestyle, but worked with my wife and what her dreams and ambitions were

premises.text: A platform can help couples track and improve key areas of their relationship
premises.evidence_span: Life Couple is a platform that allows couples to address relationship challenges in a way that's suitable for their everyday life

premises.text: Using metrics and AI can enhance relationship management for couples
premises.evidence_span: the platform understands these vital areas, and it offers check-ins to see how the couple is doing

premises.text: Digital solutions can provide a more effective way to manage relationship health compared to traditional methods
premises.evidence_span: there is no digital solution. And now there is

premises.text: The relationship health market is large and growing
premises.evidence_span: 9.6 billion and 3.8 billion. This is a massive industry

value.text: Couples can maintain and improve their relationship health through a digital platform
value.evidence_span: Life Couple is propelling the future of relationship health

notes: Traction metrics and partnerships are excluded as they do not represent premises.
